name: Kanohar Electricals Ltd
title: Kanohar Electricals Ltd - 544911 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue ₹137.1 cr (+103.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin 28.3%, but no capacity cut or discipline signal; 18,000 MVA brownfield added for FY29 with ~1,725 MVA executed in Q1 on 19,200 MVA base.

utilisation.quote: our MVA was 1,725 MVA in Q1

capex.quote: we are planning a brownfield expansion of about 18,000 MVA at our Gangol plant

triggers.label: 18,000 MVA brownfield expansion for FY29
triggers.quote: we are planning a brownfield expansion of about 18,000 MVA at our Gangol plant

triggers.label: New entrants expected in 400 kV and Scott
triggers.quote: we do expect that there'll be new entrants

triggers.label: Margin stable; future pressure flagged
triggers.quote: there might be some short-term supply-demand mismatch and short-term kind of a margin pressure as well

triggers.label: Incremental orders ₹867.3 cr in Q2
triggers.quote: we added incremental orders worth INR867.3 crores rupees

guidance.quote: We are targeting a revenue of approximately INR950 crores
a broadly similar EBITDA margin profile as FY26
We are guiding towards a similar 110-120 net working capital days

red_flags.label: Net working capital ~120 days
red_flags.quote: our business carries roughly 120 days of receivables and 80 days of inventory, offset by 70 to 80 days of payables

red_flags.label: Utilisation low; capacity ahead of demand
red_flags.quote: we are planning a brownfield expansion of about 18,000 MVA at our Gangol plant

red_flags.label: Q1 revenue concentrated in H2 execution
red_flags.quote: H1 is slightly softer and H2 is heavier

evasions.quote: Frankly, we don't really disclose the bid pipeline number as such

evasions.topic: FY28 growth and FY27 order book
evasions.quote: the answer to that is that we won't be able to comment on that
We're just checking. I'll get back to you.
